description: The $70 Annual ParkPass covers parking at more than 40 Georgia state parks for 12 months from purchase. Discounted passes are available in person for seniors 62+ (50% off) and active military/veterans (25% off).

name: Hawaii Driver License — New & Renewal
agency: County driver licensing offices (administered by Hawaii's four counties); Hawaii Department of Transportation info
description: Hawaii has no statewide DMV — driver licenses are issued by each county (Honolulu, Maui, Hawaii, Kauai). REAL ID (STAR) cards require documentary proof of legal name, date of birth, Social Security number, legal presence, and Hawaii address.
whatToBring: Proof of legal name and date of birth
cost: Varies by license type and county

name: Hawaii Vehicle Registration & Title
agency: County governments (administered by Hawaii's four counties); Hawaii Department of Transportation info
description: Hawaii has no statewide DMV — vehicle registration is managed by each county government. All four counties offer registration renewals by mail and online; Honolulu and Hawaii County also offer DMV NOW kiosks.
eligibility: Vehicle owned or leased by a Hawaii resident
cost: Varies by vehicle weight and county

name: Med-QUEST (Hawaii Medicaid)
agency: Hawaii Department of Human Services — Med-QUEST Division
description: Med-QUEST is Hawaii's Medicaid program, providing health coverage for eligible low-income residents.

name: Hawaii SNAP
agency: Hawaii Department of Human Services
description: Apply for SNAP food benefits through the Hawaii Department of Human Services' public assistance portal.

name: Hawaii Unemployment Insurance — File a Claim
agency: Hawaii Department of Labor and Industrial Relations (DLIR)
description: File a new unemployment claim online if you lost work through no fault of your own.
eligibility: Earned qualifying wages in the base period
cost: Free — benefits based on past wages

name: Hawaii Voter Registration
agency: Hawaii Office of Elections
description: Register to vote online at olvr.hawaii.gov using a Hawaii driver license or state ID and Social Security number. Hawaii votes entirely by mail; for the general election, online/mail registration closes October 26, 2026.
eligibility: Age 18 or older by Election Day

deadlines.label: Registration deadline for the general election
deadlines.note: Online and mail registration close; Hawaii votes by mail

prerequisites: Hawaii driver license or state ID and Social Security number for online registration

name: Hawaii Business Registration / LLC Formation (BREG)
agency: Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs — Business Registration Division (BREG)
description: Register a business entity or form an LLC with BREG. Filings can be done online through the Division's business registration portal.
eligibility: Business name available on state records
Registered agent with a Hawaii address
whatToBring: Registered agent name and Hawaii address
cost: Filing fees vary by entity type

name: Hawaii Individual Income Tax Filing (Hawaii Tax Online)
agency: Hawaii Department of Taxation
description: File your Hawaii individual income tax return (Form N-11 for residents) for free through Hawaii Tax Online, or e-file through commercial tax software.
eligibility: Hawaii resident or part-year resident with taxable income
cost: Free to e-file Form N-11; tax owed varies

name: Hawaii Professional & Vocational Licensing (PVL)
agency: Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs — Professional and Vocational Licensing Division
description: Apply for, renew, or verify a professional license through MyPVL, the Division's online licensing portal. About 92% of renewals are completed in MyPVL.
eligibility: Meets the education, exam, and experience requirements of the relevant board
whatToBring: Exam or education documentation per board

name: Hawaii Birth Certificate
agency: Hawaii Department of Health — Office of Health Status Monitoring, Vital Records
description: Order a certified copy of a Hawaii birth certificate online through the state's vitrec system (recommended), by mail, or in person at 1250 Punchbowl Street, Room 103, Honolulu. Government-issued photo ID is required.
eligibility: Person named on the record or an eligible person with tangible interest

contacts.label: Office
contacts.value: 1250 Punchbowl Street, Room 103, Honolulu (Mon–Fri, 7:45 a.m.–2:30 p.m.)

cost: $10 for the first copy, $4 per additional copy (+ $2.50 portal fee per order)

name: Hawaii TANF / TAONF
agency: Hawaii Department of Human Services
description: Hawaii's TANF and TAONF (Temporary Assistance for Other Needy Families) programs provide temporary monthly cash assistance to eligible families with children.
eligibility: Hawaii resident family with a dependent child

name: Hawaii State Parks (DLNR Division of State Parks)
agency: Hawaii Department of Land and Natural Resources — Division of State Parks
description: Hawaii's 50 state parks have no statewide annual pass; Hawaii residents with a state ID are admitted free at parks that charge non-resident entry and parking fees. Several popular parks (e.g., Hāʻena, Diamond Head) require advance reservations for non-residents.
eligibility: Hawaii residents admitted free with state ID; non-residents pay per-park fees

contacts.label: Division of State Parks (Hāʻena park page)

cost: Free for Hawaii residents; non-resident entry/parking fees vary by park
